transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. __. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Well, what made me come in today is that the things that usually make me feel like myself have just started feeling... flat. And heavy, I guess. 

I usually really enjoy going on photography walks, or mentoring the kids, and even just keeping a clean, organized calendar for work. But lately, I just stopped initiating any of it. I just don't seem to have the drive for those things right now.
Did these changes start after a specific stressful event or life change?

Yes, it actually did. This has been going on for about a year and three months now. It started right after a family member of mine had some changes in their health and behavior. I had to step in and take on a lot more of the coordination for them, and... yeah, that’s when I noticed these changes in myself starting.
Have you felt this way on most days, for more than two years straight?
No, it hasn't been quite that long. Like I mentioned just a moment ago, it's really been about a year and three months since this all started. So, no, definitely not two years straight.
Have you had a period of at least two months since this started when you felt back to your usual self?

No, I haven't. Since this all started about a year and three months ago, I haven't really had any stretch of time where I felt like my usual self again. It's just been a constant weight this whole time.
Have you been having thoughts that you’d be better off dead or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't. I mean, it's been really hard, and like I said, it's a constant weight... but I haven't had any thoughts like that. I don't want to hurt myself or anything.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say that. I know I mentioned it being a constant weight earlier, but I don't really mean that I'm feeling sad or depressed all day long. It's more just... exhausting to deal with, I guess. But no, I don't feel down most of the day, every day.
Have there been any two-week periods during this time when you felt depressed or lost interest in things nearly every day?
No, there hasn't been anything like that. I haven't really felt depressed or lost interest in things for a whole two weeks straight. It's just... not something I've experienced.
Did these symptoms begin within a few months of the family health changes you mentioned?

Yeah, it started right around then. It's been going on for about a year and three months now. That's when their health and behavior really started changing, and I had to step in and take on a lot more of the coordination for them.
